title: Complex slices, inverses, and deformations of a three-dimensional real algebra
summary: We study the real three-dimensional unital algebra with basis $\{1,i,j\}$ and products $i^2=j^2=-1,\quad ij=0,\quad ji=i+j$. Its quadratic and power-associative elements form the union of exactly three complex subalgebras; their nonzero elements are precisely those with a two-sided inverse, which is unique. Every nonzero subalgebra contains the unit, and every element outside these three planes generates the whole algebra.
